test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the letter-cluster that is different.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a08c777a36f898d492c29ef3a13c1a9aad5b988568e613e5a9282d9466dd8871.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 
• YGSQ → Four letters and no vowels.
 
• GTDME → Five letters with one vowel.
 
• LBJZ → Four letters and no vowels.
 
• MHXT → Four letters and no vowels.

Hence,** 'GTDME' **is the correct answer.
